brief: No tripwire hits and no new setups: 5 of 5 slots are open (LINK, BTC, SOL triggered; CRV, DOGE watching). Delta: XPL, kPEPE and ZRO premises reset last run; ZRO now shows HL funding 43.84, 32.89 over CEX, the one HL-local crowding on the board. hl-cycles reads strong_risk_off and is stale (5.2 h); app baselines and the Lab pulse are a gap (no APP_URL or LAB_API_TOKEN).
